title: Evaluation study of the workshop for adults siblings of severe/chronically-ill, disabled or deceased siblings
summary:
This research project aims to evaluate the effectiveness of a psychosocial workshop for adults who grew up with a sibling with a severe illness or disibility since childhood. The workshop has previously been piloted twice with a total number of n=16 participants. A published manual of the workshop is available at https://www.lebenshilfe.de/shop/artikel/workshop-erwachsene-geschwister. 

In this research project, we aim to evaluate the effect of this workshop on (1) retrospective perceptions of resources and burdens during childhood (FEBRA questionnaire) and (2) perception on the family sense of coherence (FSOC questionnaire). Moreover, we intend to evaluate subjective changes due to the workshop (BVB questionnaire) as well as satisfaction (ZUF questionnaire). The study is designed with a waitlist-control group.
conditions: Healthy siblings of people with a serious paediatric illness (e.g. paediatric cancer) or disability, orphaned siblings

interventions.name: intervention group participated in workshop 1 (21.-23.06.2024), surveys at T0 (pre), T1 (post) and T2 (2-month-follow-up)
waitlist control group participates in workshop 2 (30.08.-01.09.2024), surveys at T0 (pre), T0-2 (pre 2), T1 (post) and T2 (2-month-follow-up)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Healthy siblings of a person who has/had a serious or chronic illness (or has died from it) since/in childhood or healthy siblings of a person with a disability
Good knowledge of German (at least B2), as the workshop will be held in German
Exclusion criteria:
Minor or lack of capacity to consent
Moderate to severe cognitive impairment that would limit workshop participation
Current pregnancy/breastfeeding 
Current psychotherapeutic treatment due to a mental disorder (whether participation in this group programme is appropriate at the current time will be clarified with the treating psychotherapist)
Acute mourning phase
